answer.reason: Different business model: Wendy’s serves made-to-order restaurant meals through drive-thru and delivery and recruits franchise owners. Simply Good Foods sells branded nutritional snacks through retail and e-commerce channels. Shared exposure to food consumers does not establish comparable products or buyers.
answer.missing_evidence: No evidence that Simply Good Foods operates restaurants or serves the same restaurant meal occasions as Wendy’s.

citations.text: At Simply Good Foods, our mission is to empower and educate consumers about how to eat right and snack smarter through our education, advocacy, products and tools. citations.text: With our heritage of science-based nutrition, we are committed to growing our portfolio of nutritious snacking brands.
